title: Rebalance shards from 10-shard CI durations
body:
Outcome: the 10-shard plan stops overloading one shard, so the slowest Test step moves toward the shard mean.
Evidence: main runs since 2194438 (42429805266, 42430428146, 42430864780, 42431526060): shard 3 ran 14/18/18/18 s while shards 1 and 5 ran 10-13 s; node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --since 2194438 flags 23 files whose median CI duration exceeds their weight by more than 30% (worst test/worker/hardening-baseline.test.ts 13.2 s vs weight 6.8); both models correlate weakly (summed r=0.35, heaviest-lane r=-0.17).
Acceptance: node scripts/shard-weights-refresh.mjs --runs 5 --write over 10-shard main runs only; then 5 main runs since that commit print a slowest Test step p50 below 18 s and fewer drifted files (node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --since <refresh sha>).

Note: Pearson r cannot judge a balanced plan (predicted walls 43.4-43.5 summed and 10.9-11.7 lane s barely vary, so r was 0.35 and -0.20 over 5 runs); judge per-shard medians across runs (shard 3 at 18 s in 3 of 5) and the slowest-step p50, or replace the r verdict in scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs with a shard-rank consistency check.

Refresh e9ebc8f (window start): weights from 10-shard main runs 42437333036 42437063331 42436168431 42436014411 42435706998; test/worker/state-trust.test.ts (12.2 s) and test/worker/recovery.test.ts (11.7 s) split under the 11 s file bound with apportioned weights. Baseline over those runs at 1dd36d6 (node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --runs 5): slowest Test step p50 17 s, 17 drifted files, shard p50 11-16 s (shard 3 highest). On their per-file medians the old plan summed 23.5-55.5 s per shard (lane wall 9.6-14.6 s), the refreshed plan 42.4-42.5 s (lane wall 10.7-11.8 s). Close when node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --since e9ebc8f prints runs: 5 of 5 with a slowest Test step p50 below 18 s and fewer than 17 drifted files.

Window run 1: main 42438874107 (051c00a) Test steps 8-19 s, slowest 19 s (shard 7); PR run 42438789064 also peaked at 19 s (shard 6). In both runs evals/workspace.test.ts ran 10.6-12.6 s against weight 5.1 beside evals/workspace-mask.test.ts in shard 6, and main shard 7 carried worker/hardening-redaction.test.ts at 11.7 s against 4.3. If the window's drift section keeps flagging same-family files, test family anti-affinity in planTestShards or refresh once more before closing; per-shard p50 comes with t-5fs38a3.

Window verdict, 5 of 5 since e9ebc8f (main 42438874107 42439302711 42440860512 42441356963 42442106709): FAIL. Slowest Test step p50 19 s (target below 18 s, baseline 17 s), 32 drifted files (baseline 17); shard p50: 1/10=14 2/10=14 3/10=14 4/10=19 5/10=9 6/10=16 7/10=16 8/10=12 9/10=13 10/10=18 s; highest 4/10 +4.5 s over the mean 14.5 s. The shard rank follows each shard's longest file, not its summed weight: 4/10 holds test/worker/acceptance-checks-reruns.test.ts at a 15.5 s CI median (weight 10.1) and 10/10 holds test/worker/acceptance-checks-observers.test.ts at 14.2 s (weight 8.8); the 11 s file bound passed on weights that lag CI by up to 53%, so the report now prints a 'files over the 11 s bound' line from CI medians and gates the slowest p50 at 18 s. Next, after t-dddwdtg lands: split every file that line lists, refresh from 10-shard main runs that include the splits, and open a new window; close when node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --since <refresh sha> prints runs: 5 of 5, 'target < 18 s: PASS', 'files over the 11 s bound: none' and fewer than 17 drifted files.

Refresh e79cb01 (window start): weights from 10-shard main runs 42445125280 42444826902 42443183605 42443064364 42442826299; the three files on the e9ebc8f report's 'files over the 11 s bound' line split by theme with apportioned weights: acceptance-checks-observers 7.9 + acceptance-checks-containment 6.5 (parent 14.4 s), acceptance-checks-reruns 6.4 + acceptance-checks-validation 6.3 (parent 12.7 s), hardening-redaction 7.2 + hardening-allow 4.6 (parent 11.8 s). Baseline: node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --since e9ebc8f at d2a2baf printed slowest Test step p50 18 s (FAIL), shard 4/10 highest at 18 s, 26 drifted files. On those CI medians the main plan's lane walls span 7.8-17.6 s, the refreshed plan's 11.1-12.0 s. Close when node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --since e79cb01 prints runs: 5 of 5, 'target < 18 s: PASS', 'files over the 11 s bound: none' and fewer than 17 drifted files.

Window run 1: main 42446268339 (af9afa4) cleared the three split files from the bound line (acceptance-checks-validation 8.6 s vs weight 6.3 is the family's only drift), yet the slowest Test step rose to 20 s (shard 7; shard 4 at 18 s). Shard 7 co-located input-bounds-baseline 17.4 s (weight 8.7), input-bounds-persisted 12.0 s (9.3), acceptance-checks-validation 8.6 s and acceptance-checks-reruns 7.1 s; shard 2 ran input-bounds-ignored at 3.7 s against weight 10.1. At equal planned weight sums (43.9-44.0) shards ran 0.65x-1.39x their weights, so a file's CI time follows the load co-located with it. If the window fails with same-family files sharing the slow shards, the next lever is family anti-affinity in planTestShards, not another split. A PASS also needs every Test step timed (t-67jrrez).

At 183dcf3, node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --since e79cb01 printed runs 3 of 5 and FAIL at a 20 s p50, with Test (7/10) the slowest step in all three runs (20, 20 and 21 s) and input-bounds-baseline (17.4 s) and input-bounds-persisted (12 s) over the 11 s bound. Three of five samples at 20 s or more put the 5-run median at 20 s or more, so the e79cb01 window is decided FAIL; family anti-affinity in planTestShards is next without waiting for 5 of 5.

Family spread 7866a48 (window start: 80f75bf plus the test-suite-speed split): planTestShards puts each file in a bin holding the fewest files of its family (testFileFamily: one directory, same first word), the lightest of those. Evidence: input-bounds-baseline and input-bounds-persisted ran 17.4 and 12.2 s side by side in Test (7/10) of the e79cb01 window against 8.7 and 9.3 s on separate runners in the e9ebc8f window; evals/workspace ran 10.6-12.6 s beside evals/workspace-mask against 5.1 s apart. test-suite-speed (10.8-12.0 s beside nontechnical-blocker in 3/10, 6.5-9.0 s in 5/10 before) splits into test-suite-speed 3.9 + test-suite-failures 3.3 (parent 7.2 s by local medians 5.17/4.40 s); other weights stay, as the input-bounds medians come from runs where those files ran apart. On the weights the 10-runner plan holds no same-family pair (was 13) at summed walls 11.0-11.0 s and heaviest lanes 7.7-11.5 s (was 7.7-11.4). Baseline: node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --since e79cb01 at 49dacad printed runs 4 of 5, slowest Test step p50 20 s (FAIL), shard 7/10 at 20 s, files over the 11 s bound input-bounds-baseline 17.4 s, input-bounds-persisted 12.2 s, test-suite-speed 11.3 s, 24 drifted files. Close when node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --since 7866a48 prints runs: 5 of 5, 'target < 18 s: PASS', 'files over the 11 s bound: none' and fewer than 17 drifted files; if the p50 sits within 1 s of 18 s, land t-953mdqx first.

Window run 1: main 42449443692 (9235996) printed slowest Test step 16 s (target < 18 s: PASS), shard p50 9-16 s with mean 12.1 s (e79cb01 window 14.2 s), 13 drifted files (was 24) and one file over the 11 s bound, worker/session.test.ts at 11.7 s against weight 9.5; the highest shard was 1/10 at 16 s, the runner that carries the serial codex-stale-scope. No input-bounds, test-suite or workspace file drifted. PR run 42449373341 peaked at 17 s (shards 5 and 6). Watch worker/session over the next runs before acting on one sample.

Window run 3: main 42450770597 (b663e29, #387) makes 3 of 5. On log-precision step times (t-953mdqx) node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --since 7866a48 prints 'slowest Test step p50: 15.5 s, target < 18 s: PASS, decided', shard p50 9.6-15.3 s (highest 2/10 +2.8 s over the mean 12.5 s), no file over the 11 s bound and 11 drifted files. The slowest-step criterion is decided; the drift criterion is not: over these three runs 5 files drift in every sample and at most 24 can drift at 5 of 5, which ties the 24 baseline, so close at 5 of 5 if the drift count stays below 24.

Window 7866a48 decided at 5 of 5 (main runs 42449443692 42449766328 42450770597 42451168251 42452530115): node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --since 7866a48 printed slowest Test step p50 15.5 s, target < 18 s: PASS, and drift 11 files over weight by more than 30% (below the 24-file baseline); one shard plan throughout.

Reopened at 0bf0f2e: node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --runs 5 prints slowest Test step p50 22.1 s (FAIL); on the #441 plan (--since d81428a, 2 runs) shard p50 14.1-22 s around a mean of 18 s. Summed Test-step seconds per main run grew from 141 s (9c53d7a) to 178-181 s (d81428a, 0bf0f2e) as tests were added, and TEST_FILE_WEIGHTS grew from 426.7 s (7866a48, 42.7 s per shard, PASS at 15.5 s) to 498.9 s (49.9 s per shard): with the mean shard at the target, no rebalance can pass. Cut: 12 shards (41.6 s per shard) and a rule test that holds the summed weight per shard at or below the PASS window's 43 s, so suite growth asks for another shard instead of a FAIL window.

Window 12 shards (this PR's merge is the window start): close when node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --since <merge sha> prints runs: 5 of 5 and 'target < 18 s: PASS'. The rule test in test/rules/shard-weight-coverage.test.mjs fails once TEST_FILE_WEIGHTS exceed 43 s per shard (now 41.6 s on 12); a weight refresh that crosses it adds a shard.

Split at 2 of 5 of the 12-shard window (a984cc5: p50 18.1 s FAIL provisional, Test (8/12) at 21 s in run 42573583315; files over the 11 s bound input-bounds-baseline 11.9 s and state-trust-identity 11.9 s). input-bounds-baseline keeps the two file-count bound tests (weight 6.3) and input-bounds-redaction takes the three redaction and identifier-bound tests (4.4), apportioned from 10.7 by local medians 6.9/4.8 s; state-trust-identity keeps the stop forgeries (8 cases, 3.8) and state-trust-identity-start takes the stale-start forgeries (7 cases, 3.3), sharing state-trust-identity-case.ts. This PR's merge restarts the window: close when node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --since <merge sha> prints runs: 5 of 5, 'target < 18 s: PASS' and 'files over the 11 s bound: none'. ci.yml runs on push to main only, so window samples come from merges; no workflow_dispatch exists to sample without a merge.

Window note: t-ed32603 merges inside the window since c1be8de and only shortens worker files (acceptance-checks, dependency-guard and acceptance-checks-observers by 38-58% locally) without changing weights; samples after it can only be faster, and the next weight refresh lowers those three weights.

Window since c1be8de at 3 of 5 after #447 (6c39f6c, run 42576614166): slowest Test step p50 17.6 s PASS provisional; over the 11 s bound only test/worker/hardening-baseline.test.ts 11.3 s; claim-lock dropped off; 33 files drift >30% over weight (claims-recovery +67%).
Weights refreshed from the last 5 main runs (scripts/shard-weights-refresh.mjs --write); this PR adds window sample 4 since c1be8de.

Sample 4 (run 42577370826): slowest Test p50 18.1 s FAIL provisional; files over 11 s: hardening-baseline 11.4 s, evals/plan 11.1 s. Both split (plan -> plan-paths/plan-schema + plan-fixture; hardening usage cases -> hardening-usage); this merge is sample 5.

Window since c1be8de closed 5/5 (run 42577880065): slowest Test step p50 18.6 s FAIL. Per-run slowest step 16.6/17.6/18.6/19.4/20.2 s on five different shards (1,4,10,5,2): max-of-12 runner noise, not one heavy shard (shard p50 max 16.3, mean 13.4). Splits #449 landed at c845cbf; new window since c845cbf. Next lever if it fails again: cut the mean (per-job fixed overhead) rather than rebalance.

Window since c845cbf sample 1 (run 42577880065): slowest Test p50 19.4 s FAIL provisional; only file over 11 s: test/test-suite-shards.test.mjs 12.8 s (weight 4.4). Its K=1,2,4 config-isolation test (3.5 of 7.3 s locally) moves to test/test-suite-shards-config.test.mjs; weights 2.1/2.3 apportioned from the local split; this merge is sample 2.
Sample 2 (run 42578587383, after #450): slowest Test p50 19.5 s FAIL provisional; no file over the 11 s bound (test-suite-shards 10.4 s, -config 5.4 s); 43 files drift >30% over weight.

Shard 5/12 ran 19.4/19.6 s in both window samples since c845cbf with no in-step overhead (selection to first group 0.25 s); per-file history over 10 main runs shows worker files at 2-3x their solo time when co-located (recovery-artefacts 3.7 -> 11.7 s with no file change). Its 14 artefact scenarios ran as awaited subtests, serial even though #446 added the concurrency rule: the rule missed 'await t.test(..., async' loops. Five worker files now fan out under { concurrency: 6 } (local 38.1 -> 18.7 s summed) and test/rules/test-hygiene.test.mjs refuses awaited async subtests with a fixture setup (6 violations on the main versions). Window continues since c845cbf; this merge counts as a sample on a lighter shard 5.

Window since c845cbf read 2 of 5 after #451 because main run 42579707304 was dropped: test/claude/successor-launch.test.ts lost its child summary, the policy synthesised counts without durationMs, and runDurations/fetchShardRuns rejected the whole run. A file without a duration now misses one sample only (runDurations, shard-wall-report fileMedians). With it the window is 3 of 5: slowest Test p50 19.4 s FAIL decided; shard 5/12 at 18.7-19.6 s in all three runs, stacked with worker files whose CI medians run 2-3x their weights (worker-busy 6-7.5 s vs 2.4, input-bounds 9-10.7 vs 5.3). Weights refreshed from the last 5 main runs; this merge restarts the window: close when node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --since <merge sha> prints runs: 5 of 5 and 'target < 18 s: PASS'.

The Pearson r lines are gone from scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs; 'slowest shard per run: <shard>x<runs> ... over <n> runs: stacked|noise' replaces them (stacked when one shard leads more than half the timed runs). Over the c845cbf window it prints '5/12x3 3/12x1 over 4 runs: stacked'; window since 79dd29e reads 3/12x1 (n/a). Act on 'stacked' (cap or move that shard's spawn-heavy worker files), on 'noise' cut the per-job mean.
